edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned to owner in the Ownable constructor, granting privileged control of the contract.
The onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership on the check msg.sender == owner.
transferOwnership writes the new owner address into the owner state variable.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] and emits Transfer with msg.sender as sender.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping for both sender and recipient.
transfer invokes SafeMath.sub on balances[msg.sender] with the caller supplied value.
transfer invokes SafeMath.add on balances[_to] with the caller supplied value.
SafeMath.sub computes a - b, an arithmetic underflow candidate guarded by an assert.
SafeMath.add computes a + b, an arithmetic overflow candidate guarded by an assert.
SafeMath.mul computes a * b, an arithmetic overflow candidate guarded by an assert.
SafeMath.div computes a / b.
The MinexoDigital constructor evaluates 55500000 * (10 ** uint256(decimals)) without SafeMath.
The constructor assigns totalSupply = initialSupply.
The constructor mints the whole supply by assigning balances[msg.sender] = initialSupply.
The constructor mints all tokens to the untrusted caller address msg.sender.
transferFrom updates the balances of _from and _to.
transferFrom reads and decrements the allowed[_from][msg.sender] allowance.
transferFrom calls SafeMath.sub on the balance and on the allowance.
transferFrom calls SafeMath.add on the recipient balance.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender key in allowed[_from][msg.sender].
approve writes the allowance into allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner key.
increaseApproval updates allowed[msg.sender][_spender] with the new total.
increaseApproval calls SafeMath.add on the existing allowance.
increaseApproval keys the allowance update on msg.sender.
decreaseApproval updates allowed[msg.sender][_spender] either to zero or to the reduced value.
decreaseApproval calls SafeMath.sub on the cached allowance value.
decreaseApproval keys the allowance update on msg.sender.
burn debits the caller balance using the untrusted burner address.
burn reduces totalSupply by the burned amount.
burn calls SafeMath.sub on balances[burner] and on totalSupply.
burn derives the burner address from msg.sender and requires the balance check.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping for the queried address.
allowance reads the allowed mapping for the owner and spender pair.
newOwner parameter is validated and written into the owner state variable.
_to parameter is validated against address(0) and credited in transfer.
_value parameter is subtracted from the sender balance and added to the recipient balance.

_to parameter is validated and credited in transferFrom.
_value parameter flows into the SafeMath.sub calls inside transferFrom.

_spender parameter selects the allowance slot updated by decreaseApproval.
_subtractedValue parameter is compared to and subtracted from the cached allowance.
_value parameter is checked against the caller balance and subtracted in burn.
